title: SFT-02 dataset build from Task-66 failure analysis (data + gate + tests + config only)

scope_declaration.statement: Analysis-only task extended with dataset construction. No model was trained, no Kaggle kernel created or launched, the frozen 47-case benchmark is byte-identical.

repository_state.git_status: untracked files only (this task adds task67_* outputs; sft/task-64..66 files remain untracked as before)

canonical_vs_commentary.actual: 9 rows; 4 source-disjoint contrast pairs (5 approved-like sources vs 4 positive sources, 0 overlap)

abstention.actual: 12 rows; 4 intact pairs (4 answerable + 4 unanswerable + 4 pair-extra approved); 4 distinct refusal phrasings

anti_fabrication.actual: 6 intact pairs = 12 rows (all SOURCE_ATTRIBUTION, evidence manifest_absence, 1 false_presupposition + 1 plain per pair)

wh_breadth.actual: 12 distinct question openers (who 17, how 16, is 13, what 8, in 6, ...)

split_protocol.method: source-level, sha256(seed|source_id) order; union-find pair components (pairs train-locked); densest-coverage then smallest size fill

flags: [WARN] category CANONICAL_VS_COMMENTARY: opener 'the manifest records' share 55.6% > warn 40%
anti_template_gate.accepted_residual_justification: Gate flag: opener 'the manifest records' share 55.6% (5/9) > warn 40%, below the 60% FAIL threshold. The 5 rows are Task-63 APPROVED rows kept verbatim (approved content is immutable; dropping more would cut canonical below the 8-row floor). Global opener share of 'the manifest records' across all 74 rows is 6.8%; near-duplicate pairs = 0; worst sentence template share 5.4% < 10% warn. Single WARN accepted and documented; gate level WARN (not FAIL).

design_notes.note: Task-66 s13 row 4 says '19 frozen-eval sources'. Recomputed from dapt01_eval_cases.jsonl provenance.source_id: 18 unique non-null sources (the earlier 19 included a null/None entry). SFT-02 excludes all 18; frozen_sources_in_dataset = [].

Gate flag: opener 'the manifest records' share 55.6% (5/9) > warn 40%, below the 60% FAIL threshold. The 5 rows are Task-63 APPROVED rows kept verbatim (approved content is immutable; dropping more would cut canonical below the 8-row floor). Global opener share of 'the manifest records' across all 74 rows is 6.8%; near-duplicate pairs = 0; worst sentence template share 5.4% < 10% warn. Single WARN accepted and documented; gate level WARN (not FAIL).

An IAST-character + Latin-term scan over all eligible non-frozen corpus units found zero qualifying Sanskrit units, so the SANSKRIT target was set to 0 with justification. Multilingual coverage is carried by hi/gu/Prakrit rows instead.

terminology tag rows = 6 (>=4 target): STHANAKAVASI_TERMINOLOGY 3, GENERAL_JAIN_CONCEPT 2, PRAKRIT 1. The STK category has n=3 < 4, so it is exempt from per-category opener concentration (MIN_CAT_N=4) rather than failing it. Term rows use one row per (category, title, term) plus a question-registry walk (q_ok 0.75) to avoid template duplication.

These sources exist in the rights audit but have ZERO units in data/release/training_corpus.jsonl (corpus covers 39 sources, SVK-0007..SVK-2029). Practice rows from them cannot be corpus-grounded and were correctly skipped; the practice target is met from corpus-grounded non-frozen sources instead.
SVK-0026 (third-party ShareGPT-style synthetic export) excluded from all new rows via SYNTHETIC_SOURCES; 21 approved rows (Task-63 APPROVE + 2 HUMAN_VERIFIED) unaffected.
5 HUMAN_VERIFIED ids in sft_train_v1; 3 have frozen source ids and are excluded by SOURCE_OVERLAP=0; 2 kept (svk-2023 x2). 0 rows newly upgraded to HUMAN_VERIFIED.

design_notes.topic: attribution cap rebalanced to fit both s14 targets
design_notes.note: s14 requires attribution 16-18 AND anti-fabrication 6-8 pairs. Anti-fabrication rows are attribution-category rows, so the approved attribution cap was set to 6: 6 approved + 12 anti-fabrication (6 pairs) = 18, top of the 16-18 range, with 12 unknown-attribution variants (>=6 required).

Exact + near-dup (Jaccard >= 0.80) removal on questions AND answers, pair-group atomic; approved rows win ties. Drops: 2 approved near-dup canonical rows (compression at load) + 1 new term row (svk-2023:term:b012a1b4, near_duplicate_question). Dedup never broke a pair (4 abstain + 6 antifab intact).

design_notes.topic: eval coverage set reduced to 3 core categories
design_notes.note: REQUIRED_EVAL_COVERAGE = [ABSTENTION, CANONICAL_VS_COMMENTARY, SOURCE_ATTRIBUTION]: mirrors the SFT-01 9-row source-disjoint protocol (which covered attribution + canonical) plus abstention per s14. Multilingual/practice/terminology/distinction stay train-only because the frozen 47-case benchmark already probes languages and sect externally.

validation.determinism: re-running assign_split on the output rows reproduces the partition exactly
